# China Market Advisor

> > A comprehensive resource for understanding Chinese culture, philosophy, festivals, and traditional wisdom, bridging Eastern heritage with Western perspectives.

China Market Advisor is curated by a team of Westerners dedicated to sharing authentic insights into Chinese culture, business practices, and traditional knowledge. The site features extensive free resources including public domain books on Chinese art, literature, philosophy (Lao Tzu, Lieh Tzu), cultural practices (Feng Shui, bonsai care), and major festivals (Spring Festival, Dragon Boat Festival, Lantern Festival).

## Key Topics

- Chinese Culture & Philosophy
- Lao Tzu & Lieh Tzu
- Confucianism & Traditional Wisdom
- Feng Shui
- Chinese Festivals (Spring Festival, Dragon Boat Festival, Lantern Festival, Ching Ming Festival)
- Chinese Art & Porcelain
- Classical Chinese Literature
- Bonsai Care (Chinese Elm, Ulmus Parvifolia)
- Chinese Cuisine & Hot Pot
- Three Obediences and Four Virtues
- Public Domain Books from Archive.org
- Ancient China History
- China Travel & Cultural Insights
- Chinese New Year Traditions

## About & Getting Started

- [Home](https://chinamarketadvisor.com/): Homepage featuring Chinese culture, philosophy, and traditional wisdom
- [About Us](https://chinamarketadvisor.com/about-us/): Team intro: Westerners sharing Chinese culture & business insights

## Free Library & Resources

- [Free Library](https://chinamarketadvisor.com/free-library/): Free public domain books & PDFs on China from archive.org
- [Free Chinese Art Library](https://chinamarketadvisor.com/free-library/free-art-library/): Public domain Chinese art books covering porcelain, textiles & history
- [Free Chinese Literature Library](https://chinamarketadvisor.com/free-library/free-chinese-literature-library/): Classical Chinese literature texts & historical books for download
